description: Use when you need an http security headers audit of a website or URL, with a grade and what to fix. Do not use for vulnerability scans, TLS cipher analysis or pages behind a login. Returns JSON auditing the HTTP security headers of a public URL (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, cookies) with a grade and fixes for 0.007 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure.

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

url.description: Public http(s) URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com
